description:
*"Wow... my sister is insanely cool!"*

A Duke who can’t take his eyes off me. A dazzling, flawless older sister. I thought I’d been reincarnated as the youngest daughter of a ducal family in a sweet childcare romance fantasy, a cozy world where everyone dotes on me.

*"...Wait. This isn’t a childcare story at all!"*

Turns out, the novel I possessed isn’t a heartwarming family story, it’s a revenge story. And worse, the person I’ve possessed is the villainous younger sister, destined to be destroyed by her older sister, the very woman I once killed in a past life.

*"Uh... sister?"*

If I want to survive, there’s only one rule, stay on my sister’s good side at all costs. And live as quietly, invisibly, and harmlessly as possible.

*"I just picked it up on the way."*

But... my sister is acting kind of strange.

*"If you ever get cast out of the family, I’ll take you in."*

And wait, who is this now?

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)
